desk.headline: Revenue up 88% to RMB321.5m, beat; loss steady; call targets at least RMB1.1bn revenue for 2026

numbers.eps_basis: basic and diluted loss per ADS (IFRS)

results: Revenue rose 88% to RMB321.5m; overseas business made up 45.7% of it.
Gross margin widened to 43.0% from 32.9% thanks to more higher-margin overseas and driver-assist work.
Net loss was RMB310.0m, about the same as a year ago; adjusted loss widened to RMB336.5m.
Guangzhou robotaxi operations covered their own running costs for the first time.
Global self-driving fleet reached about 4,100 vehicles, including over 2,300 robotaxis.

guidance.summary: On the call WeRide said it expects 2026 revenue of at least RMB1.1bn and a Middle East fleet of 800–1,000 vehicles by year-end; cash burn in 2027 is seen at about RMB1bn.

points: Management aims to roughly double the overseas fleet in 2027 and to have over 100 vehicles in Europe by end-2026.
The CFO cited binding contracts for about 3,000 robotaxis, subject to permits; partners such as Uber and Grab own the cars.
First positive free-cash-flow quarter is targeted for 2028 and a full positive year for 2029.
Management warned the 43% gross margin may vary with business mix; permit timing is a key risk.
